title: Genetic Insights into Facial Variation and Craniofacial Development: Unraveling the Interplay of Genes, Expression Patterns, and Evolutionary Significance.
authors: Nadeem, Hadiqa; Jamal, Syed Babar; Basheer, Amina; Bakhtiar, Syeda Marriam; Faheem, Muhammad; Aziz, Tariq; Nabi, Ghulam; Al-Harbi, Mitub; Raza, Rabail Zehra
one_liner_zh: 该研究分析人类与非人灵长类面部组织增强子中转录因子结合位点差异，并通过分子对接建模TF-DNA互作，虽非典型TF-DNA结合机制核心研究，但涉及蛋白-DNA互作建模且方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: The development of genome technology has opened new possibilities for comparative primate genomics. Non-human primates share approximately 98% genome similarity and provides vital information into the genetic similarities and variances among species utilized as disease models. DNA study links unique genetic variations to common facial attributes such as nose and eyes. This is because of higher adaptation and improved cognitive skills over these sensual areas. Non-protein coding sequences represent approximately 85% of the human DNA under evolutionary restrictions, and the primary part of this is the cis regulatory regions. In this study, a total of 103 tissue specific human enhancers were finalized with help of VISTA Enhancer Browser that showed distinctive expression in the facial tissues and their orthologs were collected. A total of 43 out of 190 transcription factors from TRANSFAC were seen as binding in both Human and Non-Human primate enhancers. It was observed that factor binding sites of 7 of the 43 transcription factors were exclusively gained in the human eye and nose enhancers (Oct, Pax, Sox, MyoD, Foxd3, cRel and Gata). Furthermore, we performed molecular docking through PyMol; DNA & Protein (pdb) structures were modelled by SCFBio & SWISSMODEL respectively to observe interactions of the transcription factors, either by placing the contact surface of the protein exclusively to identify the DNA, to enable a representation to gain information about identification and genetic expression.
abstract_zh: 基因组技术的发展为比较灵长类基因组学开辟了新的可能性。非人灵长类动物共享约98%的基因组相似性，并为用作疾病模型的物种间的遗传相似性和差异提供了重要信息。DNA研究将独特的遗传变异与常见的面部特征（如鼻子和眼睛）联系起来。这是因为这些感觉区域具有更高的适应性和改善的认知能力。非蛋白质编码序列约占人类DNA中受进化限制部分的85%，其中主要部分是顺式调控区域。在本研究中，借助VISTA增强子浏览器（VISTA Enhancer Browser）最终确定了总共103个组织特异性的人类增强子，这些增强子在面部组织中表现出独特的表达，并收集了它们的直系同源物。来自TRANSFAC的190个转录因子中，共有43个被发现同时结合于人类和非人灵长类增强子。观察到这43个转录因子中的7个（Oct、Pax、Sox、MyoD、Foxd3、cRel和Gata）的因子结合位点仅在人类眼睛和鼻子增强子中获得。此外，我们通过PyMol进行了分子对接；DNA和蛋白质（pdb）结构分别由SCFBio和SWISSMODEL建模，以观察转录因子的相互作用，要么通过将蛋白质的接触表面专门定位以识别DNA，从而提供一种表示方式，以获取关于识别和基因表达的信息。
